coucheH.q1: Has he been away from home more than before lately?
coucheH.q1a: No, the schedule hasn't shifted at all.
coucheH.q1b: A bit more, but he always tells me where he's going and with whom.
coucheH.q1c: Yes, and the explanations stay vague when I ask.
coucheH.q1d: Yes, and he gets annoyed the moment I ask where he was.
coucheH.q2: How does he behave with his phone when you're next to him?
coucheH.q2a: It lies around, I can pick it up and nobody minds.
coucheH.q2b: It stays on him, but that has always been the case.
coucheH.q2c: He turns it face down on the table, and he changed the passcode recently.
coucheH.q2d: He gets aggressive if I come near, or he stays glued to me while I look.
coucheH.q3: And your sex life, over the last few weeks?
coucheH.q3a: The same as usual, no more and no less.
coucheH.q3b: A little less often, but we're going through a busy stretch.
coucheH.q3c: It stopped almost overnight, with no explanation.
coucheH.q3d: It changed in nature: new habits that came out of nowhere.
coucheH.q4: Has he changed his appearance in the last few months?
coucheH.q4b: He got back into sport, we'd talked about it together.
coucheH.q4c: New perfume, new clothes, new haircut: all of it at once.
coucheH.q4d: He mostly gets ready on the days he goes out without me.
coucheH.q5: Does one name keep coming up in what he tells you?
coucheH.q5a: No, he talks about the same people as before.
coucheH.q5b: Yes, a new colleague or a new friend, mentioned naturally.
coucheH.q5c: One name came up constantly, then he stopped mentioning it overnight.
coucheH.q5d: He plays that person down the moment I ask anything about them.
coucheH.q6: What's going on with the social media side?
coucheH.q6a: Nothing new, I see pretty much everything.
coucheH.q6b: He spends more time on it than before, but hides nothing.
coucheH.q6c: Notifications are muted, or I saw a conversation archived.
coucheH.q6d: I saw a message go by that he deleted right afterwards.
coucheH.q7: Does he call you jealous or paranoid when you ask a question?
coucheH.q7b: He sighs a bit, but ends up answering.
coucheH.q7c: Yes, and the conversation always ends up turned against me.
coucheH.q7d: Yes, and he accuses me of cheating when I'm not.
coucheH.q8: Have you noticed spending you can't account for?
coucheH.q8a: No, the accounts are clear between us.
coucheH.q8b: A few cash withdrawals, nothing unusual for him.
coucheH.q8c: Restaurants, hotels or gifts I've never heard a word about.
coucheH.q8d: He opened an account or a card he never mentioned.
coucheH.q9: Do the explanations hold up when you cross-check them?
coucheH.q9b: He gets a detail wrong now and then, like anyone.
coucheH.q9c: One or two versions didn't match, and he corrected them afterwards.
coucheH.q9d: I have proof he lied to me about where he was.
coucheH.q10: How do the people close to him behave around you?
coucheH.q10a: The same as before, no awkwardness.
coucheH.q10b: I see them less, but our schedules changed.
coucheH.q10c: There's a pause when I walk in, or subjects we avoid in front of me.
coucheH.q10d: Someone warned me, or said something half-spoken.
coucheH.q11: Has he become attentive in a way that isn't like him?
coucheH.q11a: He's the way he has always been.
coucheH.q11b: He's making an effort, and we'd talked about it beforehand.
coucheH.q11c: He buys me things for no reason, which isn't his style.
coucheH.q11d: He swings with no warning: very present, then cold and distant.
coucheH.q12: What happens when you offer to come along somewhere?
coucheH.q12a: It makes them happy, it has never been an issue.
coucheH.q12b: Sometimes he'd rather go alone, and he says so plainly.
coucheH.q12c: He always finds a good reason for me not to come.
coucheH.q12d: He has already cancelled an outing because I wanted to come.
coucheH.q13: Do they ever come home very late, or not at all?
coucheH.q13b: Yes, but it's planned in advance and I know who he's with.
coucheH.q13c: More and more often, and I find out at the last minute.
coucheH.q13d: Yes, and he showers or changes clothes before even talking to me.
coucheH.q14: Has he brought up condoms again when you'd stopped using them?
coucheH.q14a: No, nothing has changed on that front.
coucheH.q14b: We talked it over together, for a reason we decided as a couple.
coucheH.q14c: He pushed to start again, without really explaining why.
coucheH.q14d: Yes, and he cut the conversation short when I asked why.
coucheH.q15: And your gut feeling, honestly, what does it say?
coucheH.q15a: Nothing much, I'm taking this test out of curiosity.
coucheH.q15b: I have a doubt, but mostly I think I'm imagining things.
coucheH.q15c: Something has changed, I've felt it for weeks.
coucheH.q15d: I'm almost certain, I'm just missing the proof.
coucheH.modesDesc: The questions differ depending on the person. Pick one and the test adapts.
coucheH.modeHommeDesc: The questions will be about him.
coucheH.modeFemmeDesc: The questions will be about her.
